title: College ID है? Google का AI plan एक साल free
look: illustrated story (brand/story.js, brand/scenes.js), my face and body as the main character
style: Natural conversational Hindi as spoken in India, like a friend who tells you a short story and lets you in on a useful find. English words in Indian English. Confident, clear and brisk, one even tone for the whole story, with only a short breath between sentences. No acting, no exaggeration.
sources: https://blog.google/intl/en-in/products/start-the-academic-year-with-one-year-of-gemini-on-us/ (captured 2026-10-14: 'To help college students in India ... one year of Google AI Plus, free of charge', 'Gemini Omni, 2x higher usage limits in Gemini, 400 GB of storage'; banner: 'student plan for 1 year for Rs 4,000 FREE', 'Offer valid for limited time only')
